pilot.name_zh: AI 原点包容性公共服务节点
pilot.public_promise_zh: 普通入口、低位人工台、电话与纸面服务、申诉和退出始终先于可撤回 AI 服务岛。
pilot.public_promise_en: Ordinary entry, a low staffed desk, telephone and paper service, appeal and exit always precede a removable AI service island.

dimension_rule.source_scope: GB 55019-2021 clauses 2.2.2, 2.5.4, 2.5.5 and 3.1.6 calibrate route, door and in-facility control targets. Zhejiang DBJ33/T 1267-2022 clauses 7.6.2-7.6.3 calibrate the low service surface, knee/toe space and turning space. Applicability to this unlocated node requires professional confirmation.
recalculation_triggers: accessibility professional review and user walkthrough
dimension_rule.forbidden_upgrade: No target is a surveyed, statutory, engineering, tender, accessibility-certified or as-built dimension.

spatial_dossier.drawing_scale_disclaimer: The ratios identify design-review levels only. The same board is fitted to A3 and A0 and is not a dimensionally reliable print-scale drawing.

required_to_locate: surveyed ordinary entrance and street edge
surveyed building edge and finished levels
named section cut and fire-escape relation
verified power, data, drainage and maintenance points
site_fit.forbidden_upgrade: The 30 m by 18 m envelope must not be read as a selected footprint, address, entrance, street interface, level, utility point or fire-escape solution.

plan_1_500.orientation: ordinary route along the south edge; separate maintenance access along the west and north edges

modules.name_zh: 低位人工服务与纸面回执
modules.name_en: low staffed desk and paper receipt

modules.name_zh: 低刺激等候与语音入口
可撤回 AI 服务岛

plan_1_500.flow_rule: The ordinary route, exits, desk, paper and telephone service never enter the AI island or maintenance footprint and remain open in BASE, BLACKOUT and CLOSEOUT.
plan_1_500.capacity_formula: release_capacity = min(fire_review, accessible_route_review, staffed_service_review, verified_waiting_area / approved_person_area)

bands.name_zh: 低位人工台与纸面服务
bands.name_en: low staffed desk and paper service

section_1_100.blackout_rule: Isolate island power and data at the utility spine, preserve staffed, telephone and paper service, keep the ordinary band and both exits unobstructed.

detail_1_50.closeout_rule: Remove island hardware, cap power/data below a closed cover, restore the floor, and retain the ordinary route, low desk, telephone, paper record and complaint contact.

conflict_resolution.design_response: zero ordinary-machine crossings; island is a dead-end bay
conflict_resolution.gate: any future crossing returns to HOLD

conflict_resolution.design_response: 2.4 m by 4.0 m queue pocket outside the 3.0 m route
west/north 2.4 m maintenance route with separate access
closed 0.3 m utility retreat with no cable across the ordinary route
island-only blackout; staffed, telephone and paper channels remain

delivery_contract.pilot_window: 18 weeks after all G0 authorisation and baseline gates pass; not a promised calendar

schedule.work_zh: 授权、权属与公共问题确认
schedule.release_gate: named accountable owner and ordinary-service baseline

schedule.work_zh: 测绘、无障碍、消防和市政联审
schedule.work_en: survey, accessibility, fire and utilities review

schedule.work_zh: 竞争性采购与样机深化
schedule.release_gate: open-book cost, insurance, data and rollback clauses

schedule.work_zh: 离线预制与普通路径先行施工
schedule.release_gate: route and staffed service accepted before AI installation

schedule.work_zh: 停用、接管、维护和公众走查
schedule.work_en: blackout, takeover, maintenance and public walkthrough
schedule.release_gate: consented evidence recorded; any critical failure returns to HOLD

schedule.work_zh: 独立复核与启用、返修或退役决定
schedule.work_en: independent review and open, revise or retire decision
schedule.release_gate: authorised decision record; no automatic release

procurement.method: two-stage performance-based competitive pilot procurement after owner confirmation
sequence: publish ordinary-service baseline, rights, target dimensions and unknowns
market sounding without preferred supplier or partnership claim
competitive concept and open-book quantity-rate submission
prototype review covering accessibility, fire, data, safety, insurance and rollback
award only after accountable owner and funding authority are confirmed
pay against accepted ordinary-route, blackout, handover and closeout evidence
procurement.forbidden: No supplier, owner, operator, budget, funding or award is confirmed by this submission.

capex_design_estimate_cny.price_basis: participant-authored 2026 concept allowance; excludes land, tax, major utility relocation and statutory fees

line_items.name: removable AI island and offline interface

service_level_targets.target: ordinary route plus staffed, telephone or paper completion remains available in every public service window
a stop trigger isolates the AI island within 2 minutes without closing the ordinary route
a complaint receives acknowledgment within 1 working day and a status within 5 working days
opening and closeout checks sign route, desk, paper stock, telephone, power isolation and maintenance access
a critical accessibility, fire, privacy or consent failure reduces AI service capacity to zero immediately

delivery_contract.insurance_gate: Public liability, professional liability, cyber/data and reinstatement responsibilities require written professional confirmation before award.
delivery_contract.acceptance_gate: Release requires an authorised owner, verified geometry, professional sign-offs, consented anonymised walkthrough evidence, cost confirmation and an independent decision record.
delivery_contract.rollback: De-energise and remove the AI island, cap interfaces, restore finishes, retain ordinary, staffed, telephone and paper service, notify affected users, close complaints and archive the version record.

pre_field_walkthrough_protocol.participant_mix_rule: Before recruitment, an independent accessibility lead and community observer must set and publish a justified mix covering wheelchair and mobility-aid users, blind or low-vision users, Deaf or hard-of-hearing users, older adults, low-digital-confidence users, carers, and ordinary first-time visitors. No quota or participant is claimed here.

tasks.task: arrive through the ordinary route and find both exits without entering the AI island
complete one service request at the low staffed desk with a paper receipt
complete the same request by telephone or device-free service
trigger a simulated AI blackout and verify ordinary movement, takeover and complaint entry
tasks.human_baseline: island isolated; staff, telephone and paper remain

tasks.task: appeal, withdraw and leave without providing a reason or losing ordinary service
tasks.human_baseline: staffed appeal, paper withdrawal and both exits

barrier_log_fields: repair evidence and participant-approved retest status
subgroup_rules: report task completion and barriers by predeclared participant groups without identifying individuals
never use a pooled average to erase a subgroup critical failure
suppress or combine publication cells that could identify a participant, while retaining the critical-failure gate
AI-path performance cannot compensate for a failed ordinary, staffed, telephone, paper, appeal or exit path
stop_rules: stop immediately on a safety, accessibility, consent, privacy or distress event
reduce AI service capacity to zero when an ordinary or non-digital baseline fails
remain HOLD until the owner closes the barrier and the affected participant group approves a retest
a local runner PASS never changes field status
pre_field_walkthrough_protocol.forbidden_upgrade: This authored protocol is not recruitment, consent, participation, a walkthrough result, accessibility certification or public approval.

required_but_missing: consented anonymised participant mix including disabled and older users
ordinary and non-digital task completion observations
professional accessibility, fire and safety review
verified quantity rates, cost and named accountable organisations
field_acceptance.rule: Synthetic fixtures and local runner PASS never satisfy this field-acceptance gate.

boundary: Participant-authored public-standard-cross-checked design targets, an unlocated parameter envelope, an unrun walkthrough protocol and low-confidence quantity-rate estimates only; not surveyed geometry, a print-scale drawing, tender, funded project, appointment, field performance, professional approval, official score or release.
